title: [E2-7] First-connect onboarding: wallet identity is the USDC payout destination

decisions.decision: Email registration is retired (410). An existing email account signs in, claims a wallet through /api/me/wallet, and from then on signs in with that wallet. It cannot earn or withdraw before the claim.
decisions.context: Staging on 2026-09-15 held 10 email-only accounts (5 with a balance), 4 email accounts with a linked wallet and 5 wallet-only accounts.

definitionOfDone.criterion: A first-time and a returning contributor reach payout-ready state with the same proven address.
evidence: lib/__tests__/first-connect-db.test.ts › reaches payout-ready as a new account whose proven address is its payout destination
lib/__tests__/first-connect-db.test.ts › returns as the same account and passes payout setup with no second sponsorship
lib/__tests__/first-connect-db.test.ts › claims a wallet, keeps its balance, sets up payouts, and then signs in with that wallet

definitionOfDone.criterion: Partial and rejected paths recover without duplicating identity or sponsorship state.
evidence: lib/__tests__/first-connect-db.test.ts › resumes a submit whose outcome was unknown without a second sponsorship
lib/__tests__/first-connect-db.test.ts › releases an envelope that provably cannot land, and settles the rebuilt one on a single live row
lib/__tests__/first-connect-db.test.ts › cannot take a wallet another account holds, or move to a second wallet once bound
lib/stellar/__tests__/payout-setup.test.ts › maps a rejected signing error to rejected and submits nothing
lib/stellar/__tests__/payout-setup.test.ts › answers pending on a 202 and does not rebuild — rebuilding could sponsor twice
lib/stellar/__tests__/wallet-claim.test.ts › maps a declined signature to rejected and binds nothing

definitionOfDone.criterion: The authenticated Stellar address is the payout destination, with no separately typed or bound address.
evidence: app/api/me/withdraw/__tests__/route.test.ts › returns 403 address_not_bound when the body names an address other than the bound wallet (#30)
app/api/me/withdraw/__tests__/route.test.ts › queues a single lump-sum payout to the bound wallet and decrements the balance on success
app/api/me/wallet/sponsor/__tests__/route.test.ts › 403 address_not_bound when the named address is not the session's wallet (#30)
app/api/me/wallet/__tests__/route.test.ts › 409 wallet_already_bound when the account holds a different Stellar wallet (#30)

definitionOfDone.criterion: No active contributor dependency on email/password registration and login.
evidence: app/api/task/__tests__/route.test.ts › serves no task to an email-only account until it binds a wallet (#30)
app/api/submit/__tests__/route.test.ts › refuses an answer until the account binds a wallet, recording nothing (#30)
components/__tests__/account-first-entry.test.ts › offers no way to create an account
lib/__tests__/first-connect-db.test.ts › logs out by clearing the session, after which the app treats the browser as signed out

definitionOfDone.criterion: No contributor private key enters Centient infrastructure.
evidence: lib/__tests__/contributor-key-custody.test.ts — 19 modules on the first-connect path, client and server, handle no secret seed; signing goes only through @stellar/freighter-api; the onboarding routes read only addresses, signatures and signed envelopes

build.result: exit 0; Turbopack Edge-runtime warnings only, all in files this branch does not touch

notExercisedHere: Freighter's own prompts in a real browser (sign-in, claim, sponsorship co-signature) — manual QA in #31
A live testnet sponsorship through this flow — the sponsor route's on-chain behaviour is unchanged and was proven in #27 and #28; this branch changes which address it accepts
residualRisks: Logout clears the cookie but does not revoke the JWT; a copied token stays valid until it expires (7 days). Pre-existing.
Freighter Mobile needs WalletConnect v2, which no Epic 2 issue builds (ADR-0003).
A stale pending sponsorship reconciles only through an operator reclaim run (#29).
An email account whose wallet already signed in as a separate account cannot claim it; there is no account merge.
A legacy 0x wallet is treated as no wallet; the first claim replaces it.
